basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast recently diving into the world of Reddit to connect with fellow gamers and techies. I enjoy playing first-person shooters like Call of Duty and exploring new PC hardware setups. Based in the Midwest, USA, I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work as a junior IT support specialist. Currently single and loving it, I often rant about my gaming experiences and seek advice from more experienced players.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught gamer with a passion for FPS games. I learned through countless hours of gameplay and watching YouTube tutorials to improve my skills. My tech knowledge comes from my job in IT support, where I troubleshoot hardware and software issues daily.
